fsvs_urls.description: List of repository URLs to use for the working copy. Each item defines one URL with optional metadata (name, priority, target revision, readonly flag). Based on 'urls' command format and documented URL parameters (name, prio, target, readonly).

fsvs_urls.items.url.description: Repository URL (required). Based on fsvs urls command syntax.

fsvs_urls.items.name.description: Optional name for the URL. Used by multi-URL operations. Based on 'urls name:...' syntax.

fsvs_urls.items.prio.description: Priority (integer); higher priority URLs override lower ones. Based on prio= in URL definitions.

fsvs_urls.items.target.description: Target revision (integer >=0) or -1 for HEAD. Based on target=rev in URL definitions.

fsvs_urls.items.readonly.description: Whether the URL is readonly (true/false). Based on readonly= in URL definitions.

fsvs_ignore.description: List of ignore patterns. Based on 'ignore' command: pattern + optional mode (prepend/append/at=n), defaulting to 'append'.

fsvs_ignore.items.pattern.description: Shell-style ignore pattern (supports * ? **). Based on documented ignore patterns.

fsvs_ignore.items.mode.description: List of modes (e.g., ['prepend'], ['at=1']). Based on 'prepend|append|at=n' in 'ignore' command.

fsvs_groups.description: List of group definitions, each specifying a group name and criteria. Based on 'groups' command: group <name>:<criteria>.

fsvs_groups.items.name.description: Group name (e.g., 'unreadable', 'secrets'). Based on 'fsvs group <name>:' syntax.

fsvs_groups.items.criteria.description: List of criteria (e.g., ['group:secrets'], ['mode:4:0']). Based on 'fsvs group group:...' syntax.

fsvs_groups.items.mode.description: List of modes (e.g., ['prepend'], ['at=1']). Based on 'prepend|append|at=n' in 'groups' command.

fsvs_properties.description: List of property assignments for the working copy. Based on 'prop-set' command: prop-set KEY=VALUE [path]. For global defaults (no path), omit path.

fsvs_properties.items.key.description: Property name (e.g., 'fsvs:commit-pipe'). Must not use reserved prefixes like 'svn:' or 'fsvs:' unless allowed.

fsvs_properties.items.value.description: Property value (can be empty or multi-line; here stored as a single string).
